title: console views and app shell: a kanban cannot hide an always-empty lane or OR its filters, the gantt column title and the calendar start date are fixed, the launcher tile ignores branding, and an app cannot choose a landing per persona
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.2.0** while implementing hotcrm#2367 (UX card "each persona's own work first in navigation and default views", from the #2320 browser pass). The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2367 comment 6488113139](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2367#issuecomment-6488113139), and the HotCRM side is hotcrm#2377. Each row is what HotCRM could not author in metadata.

| # | Observed on 18.2.0 | Evidence | Suggestion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The Task Board kanban has a Completed lane that is always empty. A view cannot say "open, or completed in the last 7 days". | `KanbanConfigSchema` has no lane list or hide-empty key, and view filters are AND-only. | A lane list (or `hideEmptyLanes`) on kanban config, and OR groups in view filters (the filter builder already has groups). |
| 2 | Every gantt view's left column is headed "Task Name" (a campaign gantt, a contract gantt). | A fixed i18n key `gantt.column.taskName` in the gantt plugin; `GanttConfigSchema` has no key for it. | A column title on gantt config, defaulting to the object's label. |
| 3 | A calendar view opens on the current month even when that month is empty (renewals fall months ahead). | The calendar starts at `new Date()`; `CalendarConfigSchema` has no initial-date key. | An initial-date key (for example `initialDate: 'first_record' \| 'today' \| <expr>`). |
| 4 | The console home tile for HotCRM is pink, while the app's branding is orange. | The tile's class comes from a hash of `app.name` into a ten-gradient palette; `branding.primaryColor` is not read. | Use `branding.primaryColor` (and `branding.logo`) on the launcher tile when set. Related, closed: #24766. |
| 5 | An app cannot give each persona its own landing page. Putting Sales above Service would move service staff's landing to Leads. | The landing is the first shown nav entry (#23610), `homePageId` is retired, and `navigationContributions` only append. | A landing per audience (for example a `landing` key with `visible` predicates, first match wins), or contributions that can declare their position. |

## Acceptance

Each row is either taken, as a card of its own where it needs one, or answered "will not do" with the reason.

<sub>Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` lane seat (session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`) from hotcrm#2367's report. Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for kanban lanes and OR filters, gantt column title, calendar initial date, launcher tile colour and per-persona landing. Related, closed: #23610, #24766. No open card.</sub>
